sources.title: 公司概況資料表 — 新代科技股份有限公司（股票代號：7750）
sources.effective_period: 2024 company-profile filing; statement has no stated measurement period
sources.locator: 公司簡介，第一段：『為亞太市場領導品牌』；同段列出機床控制器系統為主力產品。
sources.note: Official exchange-hosted filing, but the profile states that the information was supplied by the company and its recommending securities firms. It is a qualitative self-description, not an independently substantiated market ranking.

sources.title: 把機器人當配件賣！機械工具機股王「新代」，如何從一顆控制器打進整座工廠？
sources.locator: Article opening discussion of China market; states that, according to the company’s estimate, its 2025 share of the China controller market was about 23%.
sources.note: Reputable secondary report attributing the estimate to the company; it does not disclose the market-share calculation, unit/value basis, or underlying dataset.

sources.title: CNC數控國家隊先行 貫通雲端產服生態系
sources.locator: Section「新代下一個5年計畫 力促產業及區域市場分散」; says Syntec’s mainland share was behind Guangzhou CNC and FANUC.
sources.note: Secondary industry report; no ranking methodology or market-share denominator is given.

sources.title: 【工具機興櫃奇兵1】研發工具機關鍵「大腦」 新代科技磨劍29年拚明年上市
sources.effective_period: Company statements reported at a 2024-06-12 media event
sources.locator: Market discussion; reports an executive’s statement that Syntec and FANUC each had about 20% share in China and Guangzhou CNC was another key player at about 20%.
sources.note: FTNN article credited to Mirror Weekly and reporting management statements; it does not give a formal ordinal ranking or calculation basis.

已查閱官方公司概況資料、發行人相關頁面及多個針對中國市佔與排名的來源；找到可歸因於公司的2025年約23%估計，但沒有能解決未注明期間之中國排名及其口徑的同期間可靠證據。停止進一步擴展搜尋，排名原子保留為UNKNOWN。
公司概況資料中的「亞太市場領導品牌」是公司提供的定性描述，沒有獨立排名或市場分母。
2025年約23%的中國控制器市場市佔是媒體轉述的公司估計；市場範圍、單位或銷售額口徑及計算方法均未披露。
中國排名相關報導屬不同年份的二手資料，並未以一致的產品範圍、分母或排名方法作比較；全球排名不能替代中國市場排名。
